changes.zh: 首个公开发布版本：单文件 Markdown 编辑器，加工作区知识库（索引、双链、标签、图谱、版本历史）。
changes.en: First public release: the single-file Markdown editor plus the workspace knowledge base (index, backlinks, tags, graph, version history).

changes.zh: 新增 PDF 阅读器：连续 / 单页翻页、缩放与缩略图大纲。
changes.en: Add a PDF reader with continuous and single-page layouts, zoom, and an outline.

changes.zh: 新增图片查看器，以及「在工作区中打开」。
changes.en: Add an image viewer and open-in-workspace.

changes.zh: 裸启动直接进入工作区模式，不再先落在轻量模式。
changes.en: Open workspace mode on a bare launch instead of landing in lightweight mode.

changes.zh: 文件树图标按类型区分，并修好新建文件后的选中落点。
changes.en: Split tree icons by file type and fix the selection after creating a file.

changes.zh: 更新判定改用 isUpdateAvailable，不再拿版本号比字符串 —— 本地领先于远端时不再误报有新版本。
changes.en: Judge updates by isUpdateAvailable rather than comparing version strings, so a local build ahead of the release no longer reports a phantom update.

changes.zh: 新增编辑器工具栏与格式动作。
changes.en: Add the editor toolbar and its format actions.

changes.zh: 标签页栏常驻显示，编辑器工具栏移到它下方。
changes.en: Always show the tab bar and move the editor toolbar below it.

changes.zh: 每个标签页各自记住滚动位置，切换回来不再跳回顶部。
changes.en: Keep a separate scroll position per tab instead of jumping back to the top.

changes.zh: 新增用户主题目录：自定义主题以文件形式存在 `~/.nexus/themes/`，可以直接编辑、备份、分享。
changes.en: Add the user theme directory: custom themes live as files under `~/.nexus/themes/`, so they can be edited, backed up and shared directly.

changes.zh: 设置页新增内置能力启停开关。
changes.en: Add built-in capability toggles in settings.

changes.zh: 插件面板显示提取失败、来源与停用状态。
changes.en: Show extraction failures, sources and disabled state in the plugins panel.

changes.zh: 修好「重建索引」在磁盘内容没变化时清空附件正文的问题。
changes.en: Stop rebuilding the index from clearing attachment text when nothing changed on disk.

changes.zh: 新增更新中心：启动时自动检查更新，在独立窗口里看更新日志与下载进度，可以跳过某一版或稍后再提醒。
changes.en: Add the update center: check for updates on launch, then read what changed and follow the download in its own window, with skip and remind-me-later.

changes.zh: 更新日志支持中英双语，远端、随包与 GitHub 发布说明三层回落。
changes.en: Serve the changelog in Chinese and English, falling back across the remote copy, the bundled copy and the GitHub release notes.

changes.zh: 设置页新增「关于」分组，版本号与更新入口从「通用」迁出。
changes.en: Add an About group in settings and move the version and the update entry point out of General.

changes.zh: 新增日志：应用运行期间发生的事会写进日志文件，报问题时可以把它附上。设置里能调记录的详细程度，也能直接打开日志目录。
changes.en: Add logging: what happens while the app runs is written to a log file you can attach to a bug report. Settings can raise or lower how much is recorded, and open the log folder.

changes.zh: 工具栏的标题不再是下拉：正文与标题 1–6 各占一格，点一下就改型，当前停在哪一级一眼能看出来。
changes.en: Headings in the toolbar are no longer a dropdown: paragraph and headings 1–6 each get their own button, one click to apply, and the current level is visible at a glance.

changes.zh: 外部改动与本地改动可以逐块合并了：有共同祖先时逐块给出建议，四选（保留本地 / 采用磁盘 / 两侧都留 / 丢弃）后走正常保存路径。
changes.en: Merge external and local edits block by block: when a common ancestor exists the app suggests a choice for each block, and the result goes through the normal save path.

changes.zh: 新增 `==高亮==` 行内标记。
changes.en: Add the `==highlight==` inline mark.

changes.zh: 修好 CRLF 文档里空行高度塌成 0、行号挤在一起的问题。
changes.en: Fix blank lines in CRLF documents collapsing to zero height, which made the gutter numbers pile up.

changes.zh: 修好嵌套列表之后的块被重复写一遍，以及带脚注定义的笔记被解析成坏链接的问题。
changes.en: Fix blocks after nested lists being written twice, and footnotes being parsed into broken links.
